full_text_zh:
[P1] Guji-Guji
陳致元
Guji-Guji
陳致元
信誼

[P2] 有一顆蛋在地上滾。
滾過樹林，
滾過花園。
又從斜坡滑了下去。
最後滾進一個鴨巢裡。

[P3] 鴨媽媽並沒有發現不對勁，
繼續孵蛋。

[P4] 有一天，蛋破了。
第一顆蛋孵出的是一隻有藍點的小鴨，叫蠟筆。
第二顆是一隻有條紋的小鴨，叫斑馬。
第三顆是一隻黃色的小鴨，叫月光。
第四顆孵出的是一隻全身藍綠色的小怪鴨，
嘴裡還一邊不停地發出咕嘰咕嘰的叫聲，
所以就叫做Guji Guji。

[P5] 鸭妈妈教小鸭们划水、跳水和鸭子走路。
Guji Guji 总是学得最快最好，
而且长得比其他小鸭更大更壮。

[P6] 不論長得怎麼樣，
鴨媽媽都一樣愛他們。

[P7] 有一天，湖裡冒出了
三隻長得很像Guji Guji的動物。

三隻鱷魚咧嘴笑著，
笑得全世界的人都知道他們有一嘴大尖牙。

三隻鱷魚張開大嘴說：
「看，這裡有一隻笨鱷魚，
他在學美味可口的鴨子走路。」

[P8] 三隻鱷魚張開大嘴說：
「看，這裡有一隻笨鱷魚，
他在學美味可口的鴨子走路。」

Guji Guji 大叫：「我不是鱷魚，我是鴨子！」
三隻鱷魚大笑說：「你看看自己！沒有羽毛，
沒有扁扁的嘴和肥肥的大腳。
你只有綠藍綠藍的皮膚、尖尖的大爪子、銳利的牙齒
和一身壞鱷魚的味道，就和我們一模一樣！」

[P9] 第一隻壞鱷魚說：
「藍綠色的身體能夠讓你躲在水裡，
慢慢接近肥嫩的鴨群，不被發現。」

第二隻壞鱷魚說：
「尖尖的大爪子，可以讓你緊緊抓住肥鴨，
不讓他逃跑。」

第三隻壞鱷魚接著說：
「銳利的牙齒，可以讓你撕破鮮嫩多汁的肥鴨。
嗯！味道簡直美極了！」

[P10] 三隻鱷魚奸笑說：
「我們知道你和一群美味可口的肥鴨住在一起。
明天，你就把他們帶到橋上玩跳水，
我們張開大嘴在橋下等著。」
Guji Guji 問：「我為什麼要聽你們的話？」
「因為我們都是鱷魚，應該互相幫忙！」
說完，三隻壞鱷魚就消失在草叢裡。

[P11] 難過的Guji Guji 獨自來到湖邊：
「我不是鴨子，而是一隻壞鱷魚。」
Guji Guji 對著湖面，
做了一個很兇的表情。
這時候，
湖面浮出了一個好笑的模樣。
Guji Guji 笑了起來：
「我不是鱷魚，也不是鴨子，
我是鱷魚鴨。」

[P12] 第二天，
Guji Guji 依照三隻鱷魚的指示，
帶著鴨群來到橋上，準備玩跳水。

三隻壞鱷魚在橋下張開大嘴
等著肥鴨跳下來。

[P13] 沒想到，跳下去的並不是鴨子，
而是三塊又硬又大的石頭。
三隻壞鱷魚張開大嘴用力一咬，
「喀啦！喀啦！」牙齒全碎了。

三隻壞鱷魚痛得拔腿就跑！
一溜煙，全都跑得不見蹤影了！

[P14] Guji Guji 救了所有的鸭子，
大家高兴地举起Guji Guji，
围绕着湖边跳舞。

Guji Guji 成了鸭子心目中的大英雄。

[P15] 從此以後，
Guji Guji 和鴨媽媽、蠟筆、斑馬、月光
繼續生活在一起，
一天比一天更勇敢更強壯，
成了一隻快樂的鱷魚鴨。
full_text_en:
[P1] Guji-Guji
Chen Zhiyuan
Guji-Guji
Chen Zhiyuan
Xinyi

[P2] There was an egg rolling on the ground.
It rolled through the forest,
rolled through the garden,
then slid down a slope.
Finally, it rolled into a duck's nest.

[P3] The duck mother didn't notice anything unusual,
and continued to incubate the eggs.

[P4] One day, the eggs hatched.
The first egg hatched a duckling with blue spots, named Crayon.
The second was a duckling with stripes, named Zebra.
The third was a yellow duckling, named Moonlight.
The fourth hatched a strange little duckling with bluish-green feathers,
who kept making a 'guji guji' sound,
so they named him Guji Guji.

[P5] The duck mother teaches her ducklings to paddle, jump, and walk like ducks.
Guji Guji always learns the fastest and best,
and grows bigger and stronger than the other ducklings.

[P6] No matter how they look,
Duck Mom loves them all the same.

[P7] One day, three animals that looked very much like Guji Guji appeared in the lake.

The three crocodiles grinned, 
laughing so hard that everyone in the world knew they had a mouth full of sharp teeth.

The three crocodiles opened their mouths wide and said:
"Look, there's a silly crocodile,
he's learning to walk like a delicious duck."

[P8] Three crocodiles opened their mouths wide and said:
"Look, here's a silly crocodile,
trying to walk like a delicious duck."

Guji Guji shouted: "I'm not a crocodile, I'm a duck!"
Three crocodiles laughed and said: "Look at yourself! No feathers,
no flat beak and no big, fat feet.
You only have green-blue skin, sharp claws, sharp teeth,
and the stink of a bad crocodile—just like us!"

[P9] The first bad crocodile said:
"Your bluish-green body can help you hide in the water,
slowly approaching the plump ducks without being noticed."

The second bad crocodile said:
"Your sharp big claws can help you tightly grip the fat duck,
so it can't escape."

The third bad crocodile continued:
"Your sharp teeth can help you tear apart the juicy, tender ducks.
Mmm! The taste is absolutely delicious!"

[P10] Three crocodiles sneered: 
'We know you live with a group of delicious, plump ducks. 
Tomorrow, you'll take them to the bridge to play jumping into the water, 
and we'll open our big mouths and wait underneath.' 
Guji Guji asked: 'Why should I listen to you?' 
'Because we are all crocodiles, we should help each other!' 
After saying that, the three bad crocodiles disappeared into the grass.

[P11] Sad Guji Guji came to the lakeside alone:
"I'm not a duck, I'm a bad crocodile."
Guji Guji looked at the lake surface,
and made a very fierce expression.
At that moment,
a funny image floated up on the lake surface.
Guji Guji laughed:
"I'm not a crocodile, nor a duck,
I'm a crocodile-duck."

[P12] The next day,
Guji Guji followed the three crocodiles' instructions,
leading the duck flock to the bridge, ready to play jump into the water.

The three bad crocodiles opened their mouths wide under the bridge,
waiting for the fat ducks to jump down.

[P13] Unexpectedly, what jumped down wasn't a duck,
but three hard, big stones.
The three bad crocodiles opened their mouths wide and bit down,
"Crack! Crack!" Their teeth all shattered.

The three bad crocodiles ran away in pain!
In a flash, they all disappeared without a trace!

[P14] Guji Guji saved all the ducks,
Everyone happily lifted Guji Guji,
Dancing around the lakeside.

Guji Guji became the great hero in the ducks' eyes.

[P15] From then on,
Guji Guji and Duck Mom, Crayon, Zebra, and Moonlight
continued to live together,
day by day becoming braver and stronger,
becoming a happy crocodile-duck.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《Guji-Guji》的封面与扉页，左侧封面绘有一只大白鹅正在为几只小鹅和小动物读绘本，右侧扉页则是一只小动物仰卧着，页面上方均印有书名和作者陈致元的名字。
[P2] 本页描绘了一颗蛋从树林和花园滚下斜坡，最终滚进一个鸭巢里的过程，画面左侧为蛋滚动的路径，右侧为蛋停在鸭巢中的场景。
[P3] 鸭妈妈坐在巢中孵蛋，同时阅读一本书，没有发现巢中蛋的异常。
[P4] 本页描绘了四颗蛋依次孵化出不同特征的小鸭：蓝点的蜡笔、条纹的斑马、黄色的月光，以及最后孵化出的全身蓝绿色、发出“咕叽咕叽”叫声的怪鸭Guji Guji。
[P5] 鸭妈妈正在教小鸭们划水、跳水和鸭子走路，而Guji Guji学得最快最好，长得也比其他小鸭更大更壮。
[P6] 本页左侧描绘了一只绿色的怪鸭Guji Guji驮着三只小鸭欢快地跳舞，右侧则是在月光下，鸭妈妈抱着书，与四只小鸭依偎在一起。文字强调无论外貌如何，鸭妈妈都同样爱着它们。
[P7] 本页描绘了三只鳄鱼在湖边嘲笑一只学鸭子走路的鳄鱼，称其为‘笨鳄鱼’，并调侃其外貌像Guji Guji，画面中鳄鱼们咧嘴大笑，气氛充满戏谑与排挤。
[P8] 三只鳄鱼嘲笑一只学鸭子走路的鳄鱼，称其为‘笨鳄鱼’，并讥讽它像Guji Guji，而Guji Guji则大声反驳自己是鸭子，但鳄鱼们继续嘲笑它与自己一样是鳄鱼。
[P9] 三只鳄鱼在暗处讨论如何利用自己的特征捕食鸭子，分别强调蓝绿色身体的隐蔽性、尖爪的抓握力和利齿的撕咬能力，表现出对鸭子的觊觎和残忍意图。
[P10] 三只鳄鱼密谋利用Guji Guji将鸭子引到桥上，以便在桥下伏击捕食，Guji Guji质疑其计划，但鳄鱼们以‘同类互助’为由说服他，随后消失在草丛中。
[P11] Guji Guji独自来到湖边，对着湖面自言自语，先是称自己为坏鳄鱼，做出凶狠表情，但看到湖面映出的滑稽倒影后，他笑了，并重新定义自己为‘鳄鱼鸭’，表现出自我接纳与身份认同的转变。
[P12] 第二天，Guji Guji 带着鸭群来到桥上准备跳水，而三只鳄鱼则在桥下张开大嘴，等待鸭子跳下进行伏击。
[P13] 三只鳄鱼伏击失败，误咬石块导致牙齿碎裂，痛得拔腿逃跑，最终消失不见。
[P14] Guji Guji成功救下所有鸭子，鸭群们高兴地将他高高举起，围绕湖边跳舞，他成为了鸭子们心中的大英雄。
[P15] Guji Guji与鸭妈妈、蜡笔、斑马和月光一起快乐生活，变得越来越勇敢强壮，最终成为一只快乐的鳄鱼鸭。画面左侧是鸭群欢快跳舞，右侧是Guji Guji在月光下与小鸭互动。
[P16] 页面背景为黄色和橙色的落叶，中央有一个深蓝色矩形区域，无可见文字。画面呈现秋季氛围，可能象征故事的结束或新阶段的开始。
